discovered.title: Choose your tracker
discovered.description: Turn on your tracker and close any apps connected to it. The tracker must be within Bluetooth range of Home Assistant.

manual.title: Enter the tracker's Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address shown in Home Assistant (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). You can add the tracker while it is offline; connection attempts resume when Home Assistant detects it.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Add this tracker to Triangles. Close any other apps connected to it. After setup, assign scenes using the eight-scenes blueprint or device triggers.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.not_supported: This is not a supported, connectable tracker.
abort.no_devices_found: No new trackers found. Turn on the tracker, close any other apps connected to it, and check Home Assistant's Bluetooth integration. Try discovery again or enter the Bluetooth address manually.
